title: AliExpress reviews
description: One row per AliExpress buyer review (charged), plus a free product context row and a free status row per target.

type.description: review | product | status | insights (insights rows only with Analyze reviews on)

target.description: The input value (product URL or item id) this row came from

product_id.description: AliExpress's numeric item id (the number in /item/<id>.html)

product_title.description: Product title as AliExpress lists it

review_id.description: AliExpress's numeric evaluation id, unique per review

review_date.description: Publication date, YYYY-MM-DD, parsed back from the language the review was requested in

review_date_raw.description: The date exactly as AliExpress wrote it, e.g. "02 Mar 2026" or "02 мар 2026"

rating.description: Star rating, 1-5 (on product rows, the product's average as a decimal such as 4.2)

rating_100.description: AliExpress's own 0-100 score behind the stars: 100 = 5 stars, 80 = 4 stars, and so on

text.description: The review exactly as the buyer wrote it; null when they left stars only

text_translated.description: AliExpress's machine translation of the review into the language the run asked for

language.description: Language code of the served text, e.g. en, ru, es

buyer_name.description: Buyer display name, masked by AliExpress ("S***l") or "AliExpress Shopper" when they stayed anonymous

buyer_country.description: Buyer country as an ISO-2 code, e.g. US, BR, PL

buyer_gender.description: Buyer gender when AliExpress publishes it

buyer_anonymous.description: true when the buyer hid their identity

buyer_avatar.description: Buyer avatar image URL, when there is one

sku_id.description: AliExpress's numeric id of the exact variant the buyer bought

sku_info.description: The variant in words, e.g. "Color:LP40 white" — which colour or size the review is actually about

images.description: Full-size URLs of the photos the buyer attached to the review

image_count.description: How many photos the review carries

logistics.description: The shipping method the order used, e.g. "AliExpress Selection Standard Shipping"

helpful_votes.description: How many shoppers marked the review helpful

unhelpful_votes.description: How many shoppers marked the review unhelpful

attributes.description: The structured attributes AliExpress asked this buyer to rate, e.g. {"Quality of sound": "Good", "Durability": "Fits ok"}

follow_up_text.description: The follow-up review the buyer added later, in their own words

follow_up_translated.description: Machine translation of the follow-up review

follow_up_date.description: Date of the follow-up review, YYYY-MM-DD

follow_up_days.description: How many days after the first review the follow-up was written — the durability signal

follow_up_images.description: Photos attached to the follow-up review

featured.description: true when AliExpress promotes this review to the top of the product page

ai_generated.description: AliExpress's own flag for a review it believes was written by AI

sentiment.description: With Analyze reviews on: positive, neutral or negative — the star rating pulled toward what the words of the review say (review rows)

sentiment_score.description: With Analyze reviews on: -1 (angry) to 1 (delighted); the stars on that scale, averaged with the balance of praise and complaint words when the review has any (review rows)

rating_text_mismatch.description: With Analyze reviews on: true when a 4 or 5 star review reads as a complaint — the AliExpress habit an average rating hides (review rows)

topics.description: With Analyze reviews on. Review rows: which of quality, delivery, packaging, size_fit, description_match, value, durability, functionality, seller_service, authenticity, damaged_or_missing the review talks about. Insights rows: every topic with how many reviews raise it, how many of those are positive and negative, and their average rating

reviews_analyzed.description: How many delivered reviews the insights row summarises (insights rows)

avg_rating.description: Average star rating of the analysed reviews — of the reviews this run delivered, after your filters, not of the whole product (insights rows)

sentiment_positive.description: Analysed reviews that read positive (insights rows)

sentiment_neutral.description: Analysed reviews that read neutral (insights rows)

sentiment_negative.description: Analysed reviews that read negative (insights rows)

rating_text_mismatches.description: How many 4-5 star reviews read as complaints (insights rows)

top_complaints.description: Up to five topics with the most negative reviews, worst first (insights rows)

top_praise.description: Up to five topics with the most positive reviews (insights rows)

by_variant.description: The ten most-reviewed SKU variants with review count, average rating and negative reviews each — which colour, size or plug is the bad one (insights rows)

by_country.description: The ten biggest buyer countries with review count, average rating and negative reviews each (insights rows)

by_month.description: Review count, average rating and negative reviews per calendar month, oldest first — is the product getting better or worse (insights rows)

with_photos.description: Analysed reviews carrying buyer photos (insights rows)

follow_ups.description: Analysed reviews with a follow-up review (insights rows)

follow_ups_negative.description: Follow-up reviews whose own words are more complaint than praise — the durability signal (insights rows)

rating_percent.description: The product's average rating as a percentage, AliExpress's own number (product rows)

reviews_total.description: How many reviews AliExpress says the product has (product rows)

reviews_fetched.description: Reviews read in this run for the product, before filters (product rows)

positive_count.description: Reviews AliExpress counts as positive, 4-5 stars (product rows)

neutral_count.description: Reviews AliExpress counts as neutral, 3 stars (product rows)

negative_count.description: Reviews AliExpress counts as negative, 1-2 stars (product rows)

positive_rate.description: Share of positive reviews as a percentage (product rows)

negative_rate.description: Share of negative reviews as a percentage (product rows)

with_photos_count.description: How many of the product's reviews carry buyer photos (product rows)

with_follow_up_count.description: How many carry a follow-up review written later (product rows)

same_country_count.description: How many were written by buyers in the country the run asked as (product rows)

product_type.description: AliExpress's own product classification, e.g. ORDINARY (product rows)

review_attributes.description: The structured attributes buyers rated the product on, with how many said each thing — the fastest read on what people love and hate (product rows)

review_topics.description: The topics AliExpress itself mined from the review texts — 'poor sound quality', 'fast delivery' — each with its sentiment (positive, negative or neutral) and how many reviews raise it: the product's praise and complaints at a glance (product rows)

status.description: ok | no_reviews | not_found | duplicate | error (status rows)

reviews.description: Reviews delivered and charged for this target (status rows)

filtered.description: Reviews dropped by the filters, never charged (status rows)

already_seen.description: With Only new reviews on: how many reviews passed the filters but were already delivered by an earlier run, so were skipped and not charged (status rows)

pages.description: Requests made for this target (status rows)

total.description: Reviews AliExpress lists for the product (status rows)

repeats.description: Reviews AliExpress served twice across its shuffled result shards and this run dropped (status rows)

duplicates.description: 1 when this target resolved to a product another target already covers (status rows)

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: One row per product when Analyze reviews is on: sentiment split, complaint and praise topics, ratings by variant, country and month. Free.
